section_summary.extract_value: This section presents a single study examining whether perceived relationship with God moderates the relationship between social comparison and body appreciation among 186 female undergraduates from two private Christian colleges in the USA. The study tests whether attachment to God (specifically low attachment anxiety) would weaken the negative relationship between frequent body-related comparisons and body appreciation, based on attachment theory and prior research linking religiosity to positive body image outcomes.
